conflicts.INVALID_TIME: The start time must be before the end time, within one day.
conflicts.GROUP_ARCHIVED: {group} is archived and cannot get new lessons.
conflicts.ROOM_ARCHIVED: {room} is archived and cannot get new lessons.
conflicts.TEACHER_DOUBLE_BOOKED: {teacher} is already teaching {otherGroup} ({otherTime}) on {dateCount, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}, first on {firstDate}.
conflicts.ROOM_DOUBLE_BOOKED: {room} is already used by {otherGroup} ({otherTime}) on {dateCount, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}, first on {firstDate}.
conflicts.GROUP_DOUBLE_BOOKED: {group} already has a lesson at that time ({otherTime}) on {dateCount, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}, first on {firstDate}.
conflicts.STUDENT_DOUBLE_BOOKED: {studentCount, plural, one {# student} other {# students}} ({students}) also attend {otherGroup} ({otherTime}) on {dateCount, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}, first on {firstDate}.
conflicts.ONLINE_ROOM_SHARED: {room} is also used by {otherGroup} ({otherTime}) on {dateCount, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}, first on {firstDate}.
conflicts.ROOM_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: {room} holds {capacity, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}, but the group has {studentCount}.
conflicts.GROUP_OVER_CAPACITY: {group} has {studentCount} students, more than its capacity of {capacity}.
conflicts.ONE_ON_ONE_STUDENT_COUNT: {group} is a 1-on-1 but has {studentCount, plural, =0 {no students} one {# student} other {# students}}.
conflicts.TEACHER_UNAVAILABLE_WEEKLY: {teacher} is not available {allDay, select, yes {all day} other {{time}}} on this weekday ({dateCount, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}, first on {firstDate}).
conflicts.TEACHER_UNAVAILABLE_ON_DATE: {teacher} is not available on {firstDate}{allDay, select, yes {} other { ({time})}}.
conflicts.OUTSIDE_SCHOOL_DAYS: {weekday, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} other {Sunday}} is not a school day.
conflicts.NO_OCCURRENCES: This slot never takes place: every matching day in {term} is a holiday or outside the slot's dates.

errors.NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some of the details are invalid.
errors.EFFECTIVE_DATE_IN_PAST: Changes to a published timetable cannot start in the past.
errors.NOT_PUBLISHED: The timetable of this term is not published yet.
errors.TERM_HAS_LESSONS: This term already has lessons and cannot be deleted.
errors.SLOT_HAS_LESSONS: This slot already has lessons. End it instead of deleting it.

status.NO_ROOM: A lesson time has no room

reasons.NO_TEACHER_FITS: {teachers, plural, one {The only {level} teacher is} other {All # {level} teachers are}} busy or unavailable.
reasons.REMOVED_BY_ADMIN: Set to no teacher by an admin.
reasons.TIME_LIMIT: The run stopped before it reached this group.
reasons.INTERNAL_CHECK_FAILED: The final check found a clash, so the group was left without a teacher. Please report this.

teacherReasons.UNAVAILABLE_WEEKLY: {weekday, select, 1 {Mon} 2 {Tue} 3 {Wed} 4 {Thu} 5 {Fri} 6 {Sat} other {Sun}} — unavailable ({allDay, select, yes {all day} other {weekly, {time}}})
teacherReasons.BUSY: {weekday, select, 1 {Mon} 2 {Tue} 3 {Wed} 4 {Thu} 5 {Fri} 6 {Sat} other {Sun}} — teaching {otherGroup} ({otherTime}) on {dateCount, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}, first on {firstDate}
teacherReasons.TEACHING_IN_DRAFT: {weekday, select, 1 {Mon} 2 {Tue} 3 {Wed} 4 {Thu} 5 {Fri} 6 {Sat} other {Sun}} — gets {otherGroup} ({otherTime}) in this draft{locked, select, yes { (locked)} other {}}
teacherReasons.OVER_MAX_HOURS: Over the weekly maximum: {withMinutes} min with this group, {maxMinutes} min allowed (now {currentMinutes} min)

suggestions.SWAP: Give this group to {teacher} and {otherGroup} to {otherTeacher}
suggestions.ONLY_UNAVAILABLE: {teacher} is only unavailable: pick anyway or change their availability
suggestions.ONLY_MAX_HOURS: {teacher} is only over their weekly maximum: pick anyway or raise it
suggestions.NOT_TEACHING_LEVEL: {teacher} is free but doesn't teach {level}: pick anyway or add the level

notices.MIXED_TEACHERS: Its lessons have different teachers, so it has no current teacher.
notices.OVER_MAX_HOURS: {teacher} gets {minutes} min a week, over their maximum of {maxMinutes} min.
notices.PRE_EXISTING_CONFLICT: Existing clash between lessons the draft doesn't change. Fix it in the timetable editor.

errors.RUN_IN_PROGRESS: Teachers are being assigned for this term. Wait until the run has finished.
errors.RUN_INTERRUPTED: The run stopped unexpectedly. The previous draft is unchanged; run it again.
errors.DRAFT_CHANGED: Someone else changed this draft. Review the latest version and try again.
errors.BLOCKING_CONFLICTS: Some changes clash with the timetable and can't be saved.
errors.UNACKNOWLEDGED_CONFLICTS: Review and confirm the warnings before publishing.
errors.EFFECTIVE_DATE_PASSED: The date the changes start on has passed. Pick a later date.
errors.EFFECTIVE_DATE_OUTSIDE_TERM: The date the changes start on must be inside the term.
errors.TERM_PUBLISHED: This term is already published. Choose how to change it from a date instead.
errors.TERM_NOT_PUBLISHED: This term isn't published yet. Assign teachers for the whole term instead.
errors.TEACHER_ARCHIVED: A teacher in this draft has been archived. Choose someone else.
errors.NOTHING_TO_ASSIGN: No group needs a teacher in this term.
errors.GROUP_NOT_IN_DRAFT: This group isn't part of the draft. Run the assignment again to include it.
errors.LESSON_TIMES_OVERLAP: Two lesson times of this group overlap.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The run failed. Try again; if it keeps failing, report it.
